parsed_json.sql: SELECT act.activity_id, a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary m ON act.molregno = m.molregno WHERE a.tid = 165 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50';
